task.prompt: What refund does a passenger get for cancelling a Flex fare ticket 10 days before departure?
task.expected: Flex fares cancelled more than 7 days before departure receive a full refund.

outcome.answer: Flex fares cancelled more than 7 days before departure receive a full refund, so a cancellation 10 days out is refunded in full.
